notes.title: Controller support is full now!
notes.notes:
Hi, 

We upgraded controller support and now our game works without keyboard and mouse, from installation to play and beyond.

Cheers, 
Vadjra team

notes.title: Free Scrollonoid Sprites Set
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29106243/81938adb6efc1d4ffcd32c4d08a4ee8000cc331e.png[/img]

Greetings, friends. Here's all the source material of the game Scrollonoid. Very often beginning game developers are looking for assets to use in their projects. Working with colored cubes and circles is rather boring, it could also be problematic to buy a full set because of its narrow focus. With the help of this package, you can create an arkanoid, a step-by-step game about the space and a scrolling shooter. It all depends on your imagination. Open access to everyone via the link below.

https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B7N0XJUqv7FZWWwyOHJNQTEwaVk
